title: Two 100 ns NVT molecular dynamics simulations of dsDNA and dsRNA 18-mers
author: Duboué-Dijon, Elise
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Build dsDNA and dsRNA 18‑mer structures
steps.instruction: Create the double‑helical 18‑mer nucleic acids: DNA with sequence GCGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGC (referred to as the “GGGG” 18‑mer) and the analogous RNA (replace each T with U).

substeps.instruction: Generate the dsDNA structure using the given DNA sequence.
Generate the dsRNA structure using the same sequence with uracil instead of thymine.

steps.title: Solvate nucleic acids in explicit water
steps.instruction: Place each nucleic‑acid system in a periodic box and fill it with explicit SPC/E water molecules.

steps.title: Add 0.15 M KCl and neutralize
steps.instruction: Introduce potassium and chloride ions using the Joung‑Cheatham ion parameters until the system is electrically neutral and the final ion concentration is 0.15 M KCl.

steps.title: Assign appropriate force fields
steps.instruction: Apply the following force‑field definitions: DNA – Amber 99SB‑ILDN with BSC0 modifications; RNA – Amber 99SB‑ILDN with BSC0 and χOL3 modifications; water – SPC/E model; ions – Joung‑Cheatham parameters.

substeps.instruction: Assign RNA force field (Amber 99SB‑ILDN + BSC0 + χOL3).
Assign Joung‑Cheatham parameters to K⁺ and Cl⁻ ions.

steps.title: Set up 100 ns NVT production run
steps.instruction: Using GROMACS 5, configure an NVT ensemble simulation for each system with a total production time of 100 ns.

steps.title: Save coordinates every 500 fs
steps.instruction: Configure the trajectory output to write coordinates every 500 fs (0.5 ps), i.e., twice less frequently than the original trajectories, to keep the dataset size within limits.
